notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Get ready for defeating enemies and scoring points! I am happy to announce that Mushy Score will be released on March 7th, 2024 @ 7:00 AM PT | 3:00 PM UTC. 

If you already didn't know Mushy Score is a roguelike sidescroller where you fight waves of enemies for a high score. Upgrade your character with elemental powers and use them to defeat enemies! Combine them to create unique combos that will help you to defend your home.

Checkout new trailer:
[previewyoutube=LVQ8R8_6uJY;full][/previewyoutube]


So happy to release my first game on March 7! Wishlist the game now so you get a notification on release date!

Follow me on Mastodon for more updates: https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@wawe

Checkout the source code: https://codeberg.org/PaahtimoGames/Mushy-Score

notes.title: Small update to the demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here are patch notes for the latest demo. This also renames the save file which will reset your progress.


 Save file renamed
 Better Health bar UI
 Enemies drop dirt and flowers can be only planted to the dirt
 Pop up when near shopkeeper
 Mushy Zombie and Walking Plant sizes adjusted
 Tutorial gif for all flowers
 Flower effect sped up
 Enemies spawn farther to the sides
